create_YolosImageProcessorPil: create a YolosImageProcessorPil instance to preprocess images for object detection with configurable size and annotation format
preprocess_images_annotations: preprocess a batch of images with COCO annotations for YOLOS object detection, resizing, padding, and normalizing
post_process_object_detection: post-process YOLOS model outputs by applying softmax and thresholding to extract bounding boxes and class labels
prepare_coco_detection_annotation: prepare COCO detection annotations by converting bounding boxes to center format and filtering invalid boxes
resize_annotation_with_scaling: resize annotation bounding boxes and segmentation masks proportionally to match the resized image dimensions
